parameters.name: main_products
parameters.description: Set of main products, indexed by p=0,...,|\mathcal{P}|-1

parameters.name: reaction_stages
parameters.description: Set of reaction stages, indexed by r=0,...,|\mathcal{R}|-1

parameters.name: byproducts
parameters.description: Set of byproducts, indexed by k=0,...,|\mathcal{K}|-1

parameters.name: processing_time
parameters.description: Processing time required at stage r for one unit of product p

parameters.name: stage_capacity
parameters.description: Available time capacity of reaction stage r

parameters.name: byproduct_yield
parameters.description: Byproduct yield coefficient of byproduct k generated per unit of product p

parameters.name: main_product_profit
parameters.description: Unit profit from selling one unit of main product p

parameters.name: byproduct_profit
parameters.description: Unit profit from selling one unit of byproduct k

parameters.name: byproduct_sale_limit
parameters.description: Maximum sellable quantity of byproduct k

parameters.name: byproduct_disposal_cost
parameters.description: Unit disposal cost for byproduct k

variables.name: main_product_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of main product p produced and sold during the planning horizon

variables.name: byproduct_sold_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of byproduct k sold during the planning horizon

variables.name: byproduct_disposed_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of byproduct k disposed of during the planning horizon

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit achieved over the planning horizon

constraints.name: stage_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total processing time used at each reaction stage must not exceed the available stage capacity over the planning horizon

constraints.name: byproduct_yield_balance
constraints.description: Byproduct quantities must be consistent with main-product production through the fixed byproduct yield coefficients

constraints.name: byproduct_sale_limit
constraints.description: Sold quantity of each byproduct cannot exceed its sale limit

constraints.name: nonnegativity_of_decision_variables
constraints.description: All decision variables must be nonnegative

constraints.name: total_profit_definition
constraints.description: Define total profit as main-product sales profit plus byproduct sales profit minus disposal cost for disposed byproducts

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit over the planning horizon, including main-product sales profit, byproduct sales profit, and disposal cost effects

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit over the planning horizon, equal to main-product sales profit plus byproduct sales profit minus disposal cost for unsold byproducts.
